goal_metrics_and_notes.text_raw:
By 2025, course standards, curriculum and assessments will be identified and
        implemented.

By 2025, students receiving both English Language and Special Education
        services will be reduced to 12.9%.

By 2025, 85% of grade 3 students will be meeting or exceeding grade-level
        standards in ELA, as measured by district and state assessments.
By 2025, 95% of seniors will graduate on time with college credits or certification.

By 2025, International Society for Technology in Education (ISTE) Student
        Standards will be incorporated into 80% of instructional lesson design.

By 2025, all district software will go through a standardized audit process for
        privacy and security.

By 2025, all schools will implement Tier 1 and Tier 2 Positive Behavior
        Intervention Supports (PBIS) with 80% fidelity, as measured by the Tiered
        Fidelity Inventory.

By 2025, staff will understand and implement equitable instructional, planning,
        and resource allocation practices to support student learning.
By 2025 present to voters a new capital bond
By 2025 Work to elevate to a 14% uncommitted general fund balance
By 2025 Complete upgrade of all Security Cameras District Wide

By 2025 Complete rollout of enhanced lock down procedure, including training of
     all staff and students on Run, Hide, Fight Program.

By 2022 school year, 100% of staff will receive annual training on selected topics
          relating to equity, inclusion, and workplace diversity.

By 2025, we expect at least a five percent increase in diverse hiring creating a
          more diverse workforce that is reflective of our student demographics.

Note: Communications metrics are updated annually due to the unique nature
          of this department.
